labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected behaviour (a suspected deadlock) with no runnable example yet.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: A minimal runnable example is needed to reproduce the deadlock.

body:
Could you add a minimal runnable example that reproduces the deadlock? The stack dumps and lock-order analysis are useful, but a short script that uses `Live` with `redirect_stdout=True`, `auto_refresh=True`, and a second thread that prints or logs while the refresh thread runs would let us confirm the lock ordering in [`rich/live.py`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/live.py). Your Rich version and platform are already in the report, so the example is the main missing piece.

Related earlier reports: #3125 (transient live and redirected output) and #927 (deadlock when exiting Status).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
